typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed hair-line serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was prevalent in formal French printing during the 19th century.
